[b][i][u]Nordiheim Breaking  News![/u][/i][/b]

[spoiler=A middel aged man in a tight suit can be seen sitting behind a neutral yet modern news desk with a straight and profesional face.]

Earlier today reports came in from civilian and local service men inn from the far north-eastern part of Nordland about what appared to be the sound of gunfire and smaller explosions at the nearby border, this have now confirmed to have been the sounds of a short but violent exange of fire between a local mercenary group and a band of Sal-Baliz soldiers that was most likely trying to flee the fall of their Caliphate at the hands of [b]THEP[/b] joust a day or so ago.

The mercenary group, named The Shadow Sand Guild, have reportedly told the local garrison comander after the violent event that they were resting in the area after doing some stelth exersices when some of them noticed a small group in the distance of about half a dozen pickup trucks, 2 military cargo trucks and a old APC aproching a small camp site with two tents, while this was not someting that usualy is out of the ordenary they decided gather their group and carefully aprouch the camp site with the now parched vehicles for the reasons that not only did they have military vehicles but that the puickup trucks had heavy machine guns mounted on their cargo beds and symbols painted on their sides that was "prety damn suspicious".

When they got closer they were able to see and comfirme that not only did all of the vehicles have symbols on them but that it was the undeniable symbol of the Sal-Baliz terroris state, at this point they faned out and sorounded the camp site before trying to establis dialoge with the terrorists to see if they were willing to surender peacefully but was met with almoust immidiate hostile action, luckely because they had caught the terrorists of guard the ensuing fire fight was rather one sided with most of the terrorists being taken out quickly by means of rifles and grenades, the only exeption was the old APC that two terrorists managed to get inside and use as a mobile bunker, using its machine gun turret to spray the sorounding area, for some time before the mercenary group managed to get a anti-tank missile aimed at it and take out it and the two men inside, in the end only 3 people fromthe terrorist gorup an the camp survived.

When questioned if they coulden't have managed to take more of the terrorists alive the secound in command of the mercenary group, one Omar Al-Qadir, said "The world is a bether place with fewer of these blood thirsty fanatics!".
Omar Al-Qadir, a young man, have been confirmed to have fleed the Sal-Baliz territory together with his grandparents when he was a young boy back in the late 90s after the rest of his family was massacared for the sin of being "impure" and "lacking in their fait", a background belived to be shared with as much as 20% of the mercenary groups members.
Some fear that this might have clouded their judgement and that the claim that they tried to 'establish dialoge' might be a lie and they simply started gunning them down the moment they had them sorounded, while others say they stand behind the mercenary groups actions no mather what they might have been as they agree with mr. Omars statement about the terrorists.

Regardless of what actualy happened it was discovered that 1 of the survivers was none other then Abd al-Hakim, a man that imigrated to the northern part of Nordland about 30 years ago that have been long suspected to have conections with the Sal-Baliz but noting could ever been proven with him often haveing claimed that he was simply a "man of peace" and that any claims of him being conected to terrorists was noting more then "vile and rasist acts targeted ageinst him for simply being a muslim", this despite the majorety of the people the Nordiheimian region of Olia and its islands being muslims themself yet being prime examples of dutifull and propper law-abiding members of the United Regions of Nordiheim.
Now that he has been caught red handed in a meeting with members of the Sal-Baliz as well evidence found at the site proving not only that he was infact a rather high ranking member himself of the Sal-Baliz but were there meeting them to help them start a new terrorist cell inside Nordiheim to build up their strenght ones more together with an [b]unknown[/b] group wich at this point nothing is known exept for the singular fact that they exist.

While some sources voices great consearn that a group exists that are willing to work with and support the creation of a terrorist cell inside Nordiheims boarders, wich we aslo know basicly nothing about, other point out that there isen't a whole lot we can do at this time exept trying to aquire information about them.
The Minister of War, Grand general Thormod Thormodson III, released a statment not long ago that "No cost will be spared to make sure that this unknown group will fail in whatever they try to achive"

Meanwhile the Nordiheimian chief of seciurety have said that the 2 other terrorist survivors will be sendt to THEP by plain to face their fait while mr. Abd al-Hakim will face our own justice system for his numerous crimes and lies ageinst ageinst Nordiheim and its people, we will report on this when new information is know.

[i]This have been Koen Rudosen from Nordiheim News, thank you for your attantion.[/i] [/spoiler]
